name: Portrait story keyframe
layout: Use the upper 8-64% for the character and content action. Reserve 64-82% as a low-detail key-message zone and the bottom 18% plus the far-right edge as platform-safe space. Keep the central metaphor larger than decorative details.
text_policy: Generate no final text. Preserve clean areas for deterministic title and subtitle layers outside the image model.
constraints: Use a portrait-native composition, not an enlargement or crop.
Keep faces, key props and causal actions outside platform-safe zones.
Use one structure and no more than two primary physical objects.
Vary character scale, direction and action across a sequence.
Do not include generated text, codes, logos or watermarks.
